name: Shri Balaji Valve Components Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Shri Balaji Valve Components Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and supplying ready-to-assemble valve components[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SBVCL is a manufacturer and supplier of valve components. It has a vast inventory of valve components to cater to the valve demand of industries like Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Construction, Equipment, Manufacturing, Power Generation, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical, Defence, etc.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 31.0%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
